title: Direct entry: backchannel authentication request
description: Parameters a client posts (form-encoded on the wire, shown here as JSON) to the CIBA backchannel authentication endpoint. The unsigned group (or canonical limits body) is the thing consented to; authorization_details is built by Biatec OIDC and is never accepted from the client.

login_hint.description: Identifies the user to be asked.

items.description: Base64 unsigned transaction (Algorand) or a single base64 PSBT (Bitcoin).

binding_message.description: Optional purpose text. Rendered, and therefore signed, only for clients chaining to a recognized trust anchor; otherwise the signed value is the empty string.

origin.description: Origin of the requesting surface, used for pending-request and pause scoping (rule 10).
